title: A plan's check of an option that narrows a selection plants a case the option must leave out
goal: skills/sprint/SKILL.md plan step 6 says a check of an option that narrows what a command acts on (a --lines, a filter, a selector) plants a case the option must leave out and asserts it is left out, not only a case it keeps. Found by the SP-kbrxa4c4 review (S3, ST-7lxg3u4h): the check of anchor --file --lines used an already anchored line, so it gave sources=0 with or without --lines.

run:
import sys
t=open('skills/sprint/SKILL.md',encoding='utf-8').read();i=t.find('## plan "<goal>"');s=t[i:t.find('\n## ',i+3)] if i>=0 else ''
ok='must leave out' in s;print('## plan "<goal>"','names','must leave out',ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
